Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Cloud and On-Premise offering ?

With ACCELQ Cloud, we host and setup your ACCELQ Software on our cloud. We manage the operational aspects of setup and maintenance. With ACCELQ On-Premise, you host ACCELQ Software on your own server and manage upgrades and operational aspects. On-Premise requires a minimum 10 licenses subscription.

What is included in the cloud hosting option ?

Cloud hosting option is designed to free you up from day-to-day operational management hassles.

Hosting on ACCELQ cloud accessible from your network environment.
Private Schema with data separation and security across multiple tenants.
System maintenance including data migration and application of patches.
Upgrades and new releases and associated data migration.
Environment configured for optimal ACCELQ performance
30 days backup and recovery at functional level
How secured is the Cloud hosting for my data ?

ACCELQ hosting is secure for your enterprise needs. We follow industry standard safety protocols and implement rigorous process driven framework.

Application access is restricted via Oauth 2.0 based security and tenant group access policies.
Data is segregated into tenant specific schema and backed up on regular basis.
Hosting environment is secure on amazon AWS service and ACCELQ restricts access to the hosted environment via secure
IAM/Resources/capabilities policies
IP restricted security groups
Access audits
What is the pricing for customer support ?

We made it simple and inexpensive, all included in your annual subscription.

Is there an option to host on private cloud of my organization choice ?

Yes absolutely, we have customers who are using the software on private cloud. It works out the same as the “On-premise” option in terms of pricing. And If you need, ACCELQ can help with operational administration.

Can I cancel my subscription ?

Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time by emailing support@accelq.com. Your account will remain active until the end of your current subscription period and further renewals will be stopped.

<div class="vc_col-sm-12 spp_toglmain wpb_column column_container vc_column_container col no-extra-padding inherit_tablet inherit_phone flex_gap_desktop_10px " data-padding-pos="all" data-has-bg-color="false" data-bg-color="" data-bg-opacity="1" data-animation="" data-delay="0">
<div class="vc_column-inner">
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h2 style="text-align: center" class="vc_custom_heading vc_do_custom_heading pp_faqttlsp">Frequently Asked Questions</h2><div class="toggles " data-br="" data-starting="default" data-style="minimal"><div class="toggle default open" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa-plus fa fa-minus-circle"></i>What is the difference between Cloud and On-Premise offering ?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_raw_code wpb_raw_html wpb_content_element">
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<div class="ppfaq_btmp">
<p>With ACCELQ Cloud, we host and setup your ACCELQ Software on our cloud. We manage the operational aspects of setup and maintenance. With ACCELQ On-Premise, you host ACCELQ Software on your own server and manage upgrades and operational aspects. On-Premise requires a minimum 10 licenses subscription.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>What is included in the cloud hosting option ?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
<div class="ppfaq_btmp">
<p>Cloud hosting option is designed to free you up from day-to-day operational management hassles.</p>
<ul>
<li>Hosting on ACCELQ cloud accessible from your network environment.</li>
<li>Private Schema with data separation and security across multiple tenants.</li>
<li>System maintenance including data migration and application of patches.</li>
<li>Upgrades and new releases and associated data migration.</li>
<li>Environment configured for optimal ACCELQ performance</li>
<li>30 days backup and recovery at functional level</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>How secured is the Cloud hosting for my data ?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
<div class="ppfaq_btmp">
<p>ACCELQ hosting is secure for your enterprise needs. We follow industry standard safety protocols and implement rigorous process driven framework.</p>
<ul>
<li>Application access is restricted via Oauth 2.0 based security and tenant group access policies.</li>
